recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, stylized portrait of a woman with large, frizzy hair, featuring a saturated lime-green and yellow color cast. The subject is in a crouching pose, centered vertically, with a white flower in her hair and a repeating outline typographic element on the right side.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary contrast between the orange-toned hair and the lime-green skin/background tones
Repetition of the subject's name in varying opacities creating a rhythmic background texture
Triangular composition formed by the subject's crouching posture
coreInvariants: Extreme lime-green color wash over skin and clothing
Voluminous, textured hair as a primary visual anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying the full vertical height of the frame in a crouched position.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the white flower in the hair serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down the vertical line of the body, and then sweep right to the typographic elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the right side is utilized for typographic layering.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Lime green and chartreuse acting as a global color wash.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and copper tones in the hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white in the flower and bright red in the bracelets.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with blown-out highlights in the lower right and deep shadows in the hair texture.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid natural skin tones; maintain the artificial green cast.

letterConstructionRules: Thin, uniform stroke weight for outlines
Open counters and circular 'o' and 'g' shapes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The exclamation mark is integrated into the word block with similar stroke weight.

composition.relationshipToImage: Floats over the background, partially obscured by the subject's arm.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in multiple layers and opacities to create depth.

avoid: Solid fills for the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and 90s pop aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and clean lowercase forms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Photograph a woman with very large, textured hair in a crouching pose. Apply a heavy lime-green and yellow duotone filter, ensuring the hair retains orange/copper highlights. Use a bright white light source from the bottom right to wash out the floor.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the display text in a geometric sans-serif outline. Place one primary instance in the middle right, then layer several ghosted, lower-opacity versions of the same text behind it to create a 'watermark' effect.

verificationChecks: Is the skin tone distinctly lime-green?
Is the text strictly lowercase and outlined?
Is the hair the primary source of warm color contrast?
Is the background a gradient from green to white?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the green color cast
Volume and frizz level of the hair
Opacity of the background text layers
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: High-key lighting in the lower half

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not have a solid fill.
Ensure the hair texture is preserved despite the heavy color grading.
Verify the crouching pose creates a stable triangular base.
Confirm the lime-green hue is dominant across the entire frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Crouching Woman] + Hair [Voluminous/Orange] + Lighting [Lime-Green Duotone] + Typography [Geometric Sans Outline Layering]
